title: OuroborosDaemonConfig
description: Ouroboros daemon scheduling and auto-fix policy for codebase hygiene.

scanIntervalMs.description: How often to scan the codebase for skeletons and unresolved issues

idleThresholdMs.description: Only run cleanup if system has been idle for this long

useLocalModels.description: Force the use of internal local models for analysis and fixing to avoid cloud timeouts

autoFix.description: Whether to automatically apply fixes or just log them
